bestBets.overview: Track rated heavy 10 at the time of acceptances with the possibility of showers. HARSH raced away for an easy win here three weeks ago. This is no harder and she'll carry just 1.5kg more. HIGH SOCIETY GIRL steps up to a more suitable trip after running second to Rikki Rikkardo last time. She's up in grade today but the drop in weight will assist. WUDDZZ took out a similar race two starts ago. He went to Flemington last time where he finished fourth in the Banjo Patterson Series Final. CRIMSON VINE is better than recent efforts suggest, don't be surprised to see her improve.

raceTips.comment: Just fair speed here. HARSH might have an awkward map to overcome but she's racing in great form. The expected heavy track is a positive for her and Harry Grace rides the mare well. WUDDZZ will be back with her in the run and did manage to beat HARSH fair and square back in June. CRIMSON VINE ran well here two starts back and that was on a very wet track. HARLEY'N'ROSE was a better effort last time.
